Metadata.description: Track every job application, interview and follow-up in one place.

Home.intro: Sekka keeps every job application in one place and tells you when to follow up, until someone says yes.

road.label: A road through the stages of a job search: wishlist, applied, screening, interviewing, offer, and finally a yes

journey.title: From a saved job to a yes

yes.title: Hear yes

features.title: Features
features.heading: Everything Sekka does
features.intro: One place for your job search, from the first saved job to the offer. Free to use, in Arabic and English.

points.move: Drag a card to the next stage, or use its menu.
points.list: Switch to a list with filters by status and source, and sorting.
points.export: Download all your applications as a CSV file.

points.email: That morning, an email lists who to write to.
points.snooze: Mark a follow-up done or snooze it from one inbox.
points.stop: Stop the emails in one click, from any email.

ai.title: Sekka AI
ai.body: Help with the hardest parts of applying, right next to your applications. You choose whether to use it, and your CV is only sent when you ask.

items.tailor: Tailor your CV to a job: see which skills it asks for and how to show yours.
items.interview: Practise the interview questions likely for the role you applied to.
items.profile: Fill in your profile from your CV in one step.

pro.title: A Pro plan
pro.body: For people who want more, such as more Sekka AI each month.

store.title: Sekka in the Chrome Web Store
store.body: Add the extension to Chrome in one click from Chrome's own store.

ideas.title: Have an idea?
ideas.body: Tell us what would make your job search easier.

story.first: I'm Zeyad, a software engineer in Egypt. I built Sekka because looking for your first job here is hard: dozens of applications, most of them never answered, and no clear picture of what's working.
story.second: Sekka keeps that search in one calm place. You see every application, you know who to follow up with, and you learn from your own numbers instead of guessing.

arabic.title: Arabic first
arabic.body: Sekka is made for job seekers in Egypt, so Arabic comes first: right to left, in the way people actually talk. English is always one click away.

calm.title: Calm, not hustle
calm.body: A job search is stressful enough. Sekka never shames you for a late follow-up or a quiet week. It just helps you take the next step.

data.title: Your data is yours
data.body: Sekka keeps only what it needs, doesn't show ads and doesn't sell your data. You can download everything or delete your account at any time.

contact.title: Contact
contact.noEmail: Questions or ideas? Use the feedback link in the app.

aiTeaser.title: Sekka AI is on the way
aiTeaser.body: Tailor your CV to a job, practise interview questions, and fill your profile from your CV. You choose whether to use it.
